reviewList.badText: I can’t think of any cons for this product other than it’s steep price.
reviewList.goodText:
ᴛʜᴇ ᴘʀᴏᴅᴜᴄᴛ: Scalp DX Scaling Shampoo (500ml) - your pH-balanced, one stop for hair loss, scalp scaling and nutrition. This multi-functional shampoo is loaded with 25 plant extracts, Follicusan DP (patented ingredient) to provide hair the necessities to relieve hair loss while simultaneously improving scalp health. It is recommended to those suffering from thinning hair, hair loss, oily scalps, and dandruff. 

ᴍʏ ᴛʜᴏᴜɢʜᴛꜱ: I wasn't sure if a skincare brand would deliver on hair care products but was absolutely blown away. This not only lathers up beautifully, it delivers one of the most refreshing sensations to the scalp with its intense cooling effect. But it doesn't stop there, it is by far the most moisturizing hair loss shampoo I've tried in all my years of searching. I have never tried anything that didn't leave my depressing dry hair brittle and more tangled so I'm curious what kind of science this brand cracked to come up with this amazing concoction. I also love the fruity mint scent this leaves in my hair. I can't comment on dandruff improvement since I don't have any but as for hair loss, I've noticed less and my scalp does not grease up as much despite the encouraging climate.
